<module id="fsm">
    <description>Mealy FSM detection circuit that detects the sequence '10011' in the input signal IN.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="IN" width_description="[0:0]">Single-bit input signal.</input>
        <input id="CLK">Clock signal for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="RST">Reset signal to initialize the FSM.</input>
        <output id="MATCH" width_description="[0:0]">Output signal indicating a match condition.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="S0">State S0</parameter>
        <parameter id="S1">State S1</parameter>
        <parameter id="S2">State S2</parameter>
        <parameter id="S3">State S3</parameter>
        <parameter id="S4">State S4</parameter>
        <parameter id="S5">State S5</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <register id="current_state" type="reg" width="3">Current state of the FSM.</register>
        <register id="next_state" type="reg" width="3">Next state of the FSM.</register>
        <wire id="match_condition" type="wire">Intermediate signal to detect the match condition.</wire>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        always @(posedge CLK or posedge RST) begin
            if (RST) begin
                current_state <= 3'b000;
                MATCH <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                current_state <= next_state;
                if (current_state == 3'b010 && IN == 1'b1) begin
                    MATCH <= 1'b1;
                end else begin
                    MATCH <= 1'b0;
                end
            end
        end

        always @(*) begin
            case (current_state)
                3'b000: begin
                    if (IN == 1'b1) next_state = 3'b001;
                    else next_state = 3'b000;
                end
                3'b001: begin
                    if (IN == 1'b0) next_state = 3'b010;
                    else next_state = 3'b001;
                end
                3'b010: begin
                    if (IN == 1'b0) next_state = 3'b010;
                    else next_state = 3'b011;
                end
                3'b011: begin
                    if (IN == 1'b1) next_state = 3'b100;
                    else next_state = 3'b011;
                end
                3'b100: begin
                    if (IN == 1'b1) next_state = 3'b101;
                    else next_state = 3'b100;
                end
                3'b101: begin
                    if (IN == 1'b1) next_state = 3'b110;
                    else next_state = 3'b101;
                end
                3'b110: begin
                    if (IN == 1'b1) next_state = 3'b111;
                    else next_state = 3'b110;
                end
                3'b111: begin
                    if (IN == 1'b0) next_state = 3'b111;
                    else next_state = 3'b000;
                end
                default: next_state = 3'b000;
            endcase
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
